we have designed a broker for selecting servers in a highly replicated environment that maximizes client buffer utilization and that we have built a collaborative multimedia presentation system that uses the broker to provide efficient multimedia presentations.
ALB is a content-based, server selection broker that can be used to enhance the performance of a highly replicated and distributed multimedia server.

the ALB approach can improve the overall performance of a collaborative multimedia system by reducing network traffic and client buffer utilization, and by increasing the number of concurrent sessions.

the design of a collaborative, multimedia presentation system for a large number of users in an environment of multiple servers.
the development of a new generation of multimedia presentation services, which can be accessed from anywhere and anytime.
